title: AEROSONIC Sonifier — AI Framework Documentation
description: The AEROSONIC Sonifier AI Framework is a conceptual architecture for an unsupervised, multi-agent system that transforms meteorological and environmental data into real-time musical behaviour. This documentation describes the system's agents, anomaly detection processes, dreaming mechanisms, harmonic and chaotic states, data flows, conceptual mapping strategies and scientific context. Developed within the FCT CEEC-IND Grant 2024.09158.CEECIND — 'AI as Catalyst'. No source code or proprietary implementation is included.
